v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Elísabeth Zacharíæ * magnum virum génuit, Ioánnem Baptístam, præcursórem Dómini.
text.en: Elizabeth, the wife of Zacharias, * was the mother of a mighty man, even of John the Baptist, the Fore-runner of the Lord.

text.la: Innuébant patri eius * quem vellet vocári eum: et scripsit dicens: Ioánnes est nomen eius.
text.en: They made signs to his father * how he would have him called; and he asked for a writing-table, and wrote, saying: His name is John.

text.la: Ioánnes vocábitur * nomen eius: et in nativitáte eius multi gaudébunt.
text.en: Thou shalt call his name John; * and many shall rejoice at his birth.

text.la: Inter natos mulíerum * non surréxit maior Ioánne Baptísta.
text.en: Among them that are born of women * there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist.

text.la: Tu, puer, * Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis; præíbis ante Dóminum paráre vias eius.
text.en: Thou, child, shalt be called the Prophet of the Highest; * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord, to prepare His ways.

text.la: Audíte, ínsulæ, et atténdite, pópuli de longe: Dóminus ab útero vocávit me, de ventre matris meæ recordátus est nóminis mei.
text.en: Give ear, ye islands, and hearken, ye people from afar. The Lord hath called me from the womb, from the bowels of my mother he hath been mindful of my name.

v.en: The child shall be great in the sight of the Lord.

r.la: Nam et manus eius cum ipso est.
r.en: For His hand is with him.

text.la: Puer * qui natus est nobis, plus quam prophéta est: hic est enim, de quo Salvátor ait: Inter natos mulíerum non surréxit maior Ioánne Baptísta.
text.en: The child, that unto us is born, * is much more than a Prophet, for this is he of whom the Saviour saith: Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist.

text.la: Deus, qui præséntem diem honorábilem nobis in beáti Ioánnis nativitáte fecísti: da pópulis tuis spirituálium grátiam gaudiórum; et ómnium fidélium mentes dírige in viam salútis ætérnæ.
text.en: O God, Who hast made this day to be honourable in our eyes because of the Birth of the blessed John, graciously quicken thy people with spiritual joy, and order the minds of all the faithful in the way of everlasting salvation.

text.la: Cognovérunt omnes a Dan usque Bersabée, quod fidélis Sámuel prophéta esset Dómini.
text.en: And they all knew, from Dan even unto Beersheba, that Samuel was established to be a Prophet of the Lord.

v.la: Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
v.en: Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.

r.la: Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
r.en: And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

text.la: Protéctor in te sperántium, Deus, sine quo nihil est válidum, nihil sanctum; multíplica super nos misericórdiam tuam; ut, te rectóre, te duce, sic transeámus per bona temporália, ut non amittámus ætérna.
text.en: O God, the protector of all them that trust in thee, without whom nothing is strong, nothing is holy; increase and multiply upon us thy mercy, that thou being our ruler and guide, we may so pass through things temporal, that we finally lose not the things eternal.
